items.text: Read the earlier security audit so this pass attacked new ground
Attack authentication and session handling (login, refresh, reset, OAuth, role escalation)
Attack authorization on every route for cross-account access
Attack input handling: injection, SSRF, XSS, redirects, uploads, crawler output
Attack money and booking integrity plus rate limiting
Verify each candidate finding against the real code and a live probe
Fix the ten confirmed issues with regression tests
Run type check, 453 server tests, lint and production build
Write the round two audit note and commit each fix, then push
